# 06 A quoted label loses its quotes

## Outcome

`A["Quoted, with comma"]` draws the label `Quoted, with comma`. The quotes are syntax, and syntax
does not belong in the picture.

## Why this ticket exists

Today the quotes are drawn. This is one of the five silent mis-renders — no diagnostic, wrong
output — and it is the one whose fix is *support* rather than rejection, which is why it is here
rather than in ticket 02.

Quoting is how a Mermaid author escapes a label containing the characters the grammar would
otherwise eat. Drawing the quotes makes the escape hatch visible in the output, so an author who
needed it is punished for using it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `A["Quoted, with comma"]` has the label `Quoted, with comma` — quotes stripped, comma kept.
- [x] Quoting is what makes the comma safe. Assert that the quoted form survives in a context
      where the unquoted one would not, so the test shows *why* the feature exists rather than
      only that it strips two characters.
- [x] An unquoted label is untouched: `A[plain]` is still `plain`, and a label with a quote in the
      middle (`A[say "hi" now]`) is not mangled. Decide what Mermaid does with that case and match
      it; say which in your report.
- [x] An empty quoted label `A[""]` and a label that is only quotes are handled deliberately, not
      by accident. State the choice.
- [x] **This ticket does not implement Markdown string labels.** ``A["`**bold**`"]`` stays
      rejected, and ticket 02 gave it its own diagnostic naming it as Markdown rather than as a
      plain quoted label — so lifting the quoted-label refusal must not accidentally lift that one — it is a rendering feature, not a quoting one, and
      half-implementing it would put backticks in a label instead of bold text, which is the same
      class of bug this board exists to remove.
- [x] Whether quoting applies anywhere else a label is written — an edge endpoint, a `:::` line —
      is checked and stated, not assumed. Consistency here is cheap now and expensive later.
- [x] **Corrected after ticket 02.** The corpus's `fc-text-quoted` entry is now `rejected`, not
      `silently-wrong` — ticket 02 refused the quoted label rather than leaving it half-drawn, so
      this ticket moves it `rejected` → `supported` with an `assert` on the label text.
      `REJECTED` falls by one (39 → 38 as you inherit it after ticket 03); `SILENTLY_WRONG` is
      unchanged at 2 and this ticket must not touch it.
